name: Delivery Hero
note: Online food delivery, Berlin (Frankfurt: DHER, IPO 2017). HV reached Delivery Hero through Lieferheld: HV and Team Europe gave Lieferheld EUR 1M start capital (2010) and joined its EUR 4M round of spring 2011 (deutsche-startups, 2011-11-16); Delivery Hero took over Lieferheld in Feb 2012 and 'the previous Lieferheld shareholders now receive shares in Delivery Hero' (deutsche-startups, 2012-02-28), which is sale consideration (D4). HV then put new money into Delivery Hero itself in the ~EUR 25M round of April 2012 (The Next Web, 2012-04-02, names Holtzbrinck Ventures; Focus had reported the round with Holtzbrinck among the investors), so the row is a member on that entry; that round is not named as a series, so the stage is undetermined. Lieferheld is its own row (acquired, 2012). Market cap EUR 11.10B (stockanalysis, 2026-09-29) @ ECB 2026-09-29 (EUR/USD 1.1355) = $12.60B. Uber's takeover offer (~$14.8B) is board-backed but has not closed, so the status stays public.
